pages.text: Empty-hand use opens the same-dimension registry. Name this station (up to 32 characters), save, then select another flower. Blank restores coordinates; coordinates distinguish duplicate names. Redstone enables all living entities, including sneaking players, at 10 mana per success. Bind a filled mana pool. Refresh the panel to see why transport is waiting.

The target must be loaded with supported, unobstructed, safe footing. Farmland uses its actual surface height. No cross-dimension travel or forced loading. A shared 40-tick cooldown and arrival latch prevent bouncing: leave the arrival area before returning. Blocked landing, insufficient mana and power off never charge mana.
